direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden; rows 48px header / 44px guide / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; at 1366x768 use 184px vertical step rail / minmax(0,1fr) stage / 360px inspector; stage minimum 55vw x 60vh; no page scroll, internal scroll only in inspector and task lists; refit tight panels before reducing type; all targets at least 36px; preserve fit on step 4 and step 8 by compressing proposal cards before truncating labels
direction.colorTokens: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22); silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, silverDim rgba(197,204,212,.68); primary neon #A8F04A with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stoppedRed #E5484D reserved exclusively for stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text, never for RECEIVING hold; official logo immutable black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story, never recolored, cropped, redrawn or duplicated in the live stage, inspector or later steps
direction.typography: System sans; 24/30 stage title, 15/20 panel title, 13/19 body, 11/14 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; enlarge any stage label under 11px to 11px minimum; keep Certificate 120, Receiving 80, 70 parts at risk, 2 orders and 36h on one aligned metric row with no overlap
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on real state change, then static; no loops or pulses; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, marker and text still carry meaning; 2px neon focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element; pointer style only on enabled controls; disabled primaries keep readable silverDim text and an explicit reason
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story on step 1 carries the second and final logo placement; vertical step rail from one steps array with aria-current, arrow-key movement and 36-40px targets, replacing the clipped horizontal scroller that cuts off steps 08-09; guide strip with no duplicate primary; focusable cinematic factory stage SVG; inspector 360px keeping pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity visually and semantically separate from the distinct investigation evidence task, with separate headings, status and controls; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form already shown in the inspector; pending task proposals stay deliberately untracked until human approval, while blocked prior tasks remain visible beside an approved recovery plan as replacement tasks await approval; skip-to-stage first, then header, rail, guide, SVG nodes, inspector and action bar in tab order; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite announces results only
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in neon, silver for idle machines, red only for stopped CELL-MILL-2, never a route through the offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap inside the stage bounds, clearing DOCK and MAT-ALLOY-A labels; bidirectional SVG-to-inspector highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted legend using pattern, marker and text; on step 5 preview CELL-MILL-2 with hatched PREVIEW state distinct from applied stopped red; on steps 6-7 show 3 to 2 feasible paths and the constrained split option with hatch plus text in both stage and inspector

fixes.change: Replace the clipped horizontal step scroller with the 184px vertical rail so steps 08-09 and aria-current are fully visible at 1366x768.
Move RECEIVING hold styling from stopped red to held hatch plus HOLD text; reserve red solely for CELL-MILL-2 when stopped.
Keep this as the opening story with the second logo placement, then enlarge JOB-1001 and JOB-1002 due labels to 11px minimum and give SVG nodes a 2px focus ring.
Remove the extra logo inside the live stage; logos remain only in the header and step 1 opening story.
Refit the factory SVG so Receiving, DOCK and MAT-ALLOY-A labels no longer overlap machine bodies, and the Certificate/Receiving tracks align without crowding DOES NOT MATCH.

Separate ROUTE HEALTH PRE-FLIGHT for nonce/identity from INVESTIGATION SOURCE EVIDENCE with distinct headings, status chips and controls, and enlarge the overlapping evidence captions at the stage bottom to 11px with clear spacing.
Remove the duplicated stage logo and keep the typed consent form tied to the selected path: changing selection must update plan name, exact phrase and character count in the same inspector panel.

Enlarge the small option chips and evidence captions, add a visible focus ring to each Select this path control, and state Accept stays disabled until the exact phrase matches directly beside the disabled primary.
Align the three tradeoff cards in stage and inspector by finish and cost so 83h/$0.00, 35h/$3,115.00 and 17.5h/$3,202.50 highlight bidirectionally on hover and keyboard focus.
Remove the duplicated stage logo and reduce empty stage area by enlarging the t1 proposal card and t1/t2/t3 selector row to fill the stage without pushing the action bar off-screen.

Resolve the duplicate primaries: keep Approve in the action bar as the single primary and make Review proposed tasks in the inspector a secondary control, or vice versa, with Decline clearly secondary.
Label the proposal consistently as 3 PROPOSED and UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL in both panels, sync the due time to one value, and add numbered keyboard targets of at least 36px for tasks 1-3.
Remove the duplicated stage logo and refit the preview labels so DOCK, QA, MAT-ALLOY-B and RECOVERY FLOW text do not collide with machine outlines or route lines.
Make CELL-MILL-2 preview visually distinct with silver hatch and PREVIEW WILL GO OFFLINE text; do not use stopped red until the shock is applied, and keep Apply second shock as the only primary.
Enlarge the capacity readout 24h to 0h and link the inspector CELL-MILL-2 row to the SVG node on focus and hover with a 240ms trace that settles static under reduced motion.
Remove the duplicated stage logo; keep the correct stopped treatment on CELL-MILL-2 with red outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text as the sole red exception.
Refit the left labels so Receiving, DOCK and MAT-ALLOY-A clear the held machine, and separate the bottom evidence captions that currently run together.

Keep pre-flight nonce/identity checks separate from the investigation evidence task, and mark Split available capacity as constrained with hatch plus text in the stage card to match the 3 to 2 feasible paths state.
Remove the duplicated stage logo and preserve the strong constrained card: keep hatch plus CONSTRAINED text and the reason Split requires at least two online compatible cells at 11px minimum.
Add focus rings and bidirectional highlighting between inspector paths and stage cards, with the selected Use verified substitute card matching in both places.
Place the invalidated status PRIOR ACCEPTANCE INVALIDATED beside the disabled Accept revised decision primary so the typed consent requirement is understood without scanning the inspector bottom.
Remove the duplicated stage logo and shrink the inspector proposal scroll region so Review proposed tasks and Decline stay visible without overlapping the action bar at 768px height.
Keep 3 BLOCKED prior tasks visually separate from the 3 PROPOSED replacements awaiting approval, with blocked hatch and proposed dashed outlines plus text labels, never merging the two lists.
Resolve duplicate primaries by keeping Approve revised tasks as the single action-bar primary and demoting Review proposed tasks to secondary; prevent the centre status text from truncating.
Remove the duplicated stage logo and enlarge the three stage cards VERIFY LEDGER READY, SEAL PACKET LOCKED and RETAIN CHECKPOINT LOCKED so sequence state is readable from the stage alone.
Keep Verify ledger as the only primary, show why steps 2 and 3 are locked beside their controls, and give the passphrase field a persistent label, character guidance and focus ring.
Align the before-after metrics 70 parts, 35h accepted plan and 48h versus replenishment on one baseline with tabular numerals and 11px minimum captions.
Remove the duplicated stage logo if present in this state and confirm no logo appears beyond header plus step 1 opening story; keep CELL-MILL-2 offline retained in the final status line.
Make the three SEALED cards focusable with text and check marker, not color alone, and keep Export independent checkpoint state consistent between stage completion and inspector Complete labels.
Replace the missing primary with a clear completion status in the action bar centre and keep Back as secondary, so the sealed packet line remains fully visible at 1366x768.
